Noor CS: FYI Cerulean dropped a vendor security + DPA questionnaire. Main asks: embeddings retention policy, BYOK options, and a signed deletion attestation. They want a single PDF packet by Tue COB. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Diego Sec: I can confirm crypto + retention mechanics. Quick Q: are they Hosted or considering Dedicated? That changes BYOK options and migration notes.
Jordan AE: Hosted for now, but procurement says BYOK requirement could make them push to Dedicated. Renewal risk is high if we can't provide a clear attestation.
Mason (onboarding): Uploading the questionnaire and current subprocessor list to the account folder: https://files.redwood/cerulean/vendor-quest-2024.pdf
ops-bot: New ticket: CS-3033 "Cerulean: vendor form + retention attestation" assigned to Noor CS.
Talia Legal: I'll review the DPA clause they referenced. If they want a contract-level deletion attestation we may need a quick addendum template.
Diego Sec: Short technical snippets to include: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit, keys KMS-managed. No per-object BYOK on Hosted. Per-tenant retention config exists; default workflow: mark deleted -> async purge job -> full purge within 30 days.
Diego Sec: Sample audit log to include: ```
DELETE_JOB account=cerulean-42 job_id=del_20240615_1147 status=completed items=382 ts=2024-06-15T11:47:12Z
```
Noor CS: Good — we'll embed that as proof. Action items: Diego 1: confirm key provenance statement + sample log by EOD today. Talia 1: DPA addendum draft and suggested attestation language by tomorrow AM. Mason 1: data lifecycle one-pager + where embeddings live (hot/cold) by tomorrow. Jordan 1: draft migration time/cost if BYOK required.
Mason (onboarding): Quick note: cold-tiering may move shards cross-region for cost-savings. We can region-lock manually (ops request) but it's a 48-72h manual process and may affect pricing. Adding that to the lifecycle doc.
Talia Legal: For the attestation, suggest wording: "Upon account termination, Redwood executes its deletion workflow and provides audit evidence including job IDs and timestamps. Full purge completes within 30 days," — I'll draft formal wording.
Jordan AE: Procurement also wants to know who signs the attestation (CS vs Legal). Prefer Legal-signed PDF.
Noor CS: OK, plan: assemble a single PDF packet with 1) SOC2 excerpt 2) DPA redlines/addendum 3) data lifecycle one-pager 4) attestation template 5) migration estimate. Review meeting scheduled tomorrow 2pm PT. Invite sent.
Diego Sec: Uploading crypto wording + one sample GCP KMS provenance snippet to CS-3033 now.
Mason (onboarding): Draft one-pager uploaded to ticket. It explicitly calls out retention SLA, cold-tier behavior, and manual region-lock steps.
Talia Legal: Drafted the attestation and posted comments. Will join 2pm review.
Jordan AE: Posted a conservative BYOK migration ballpark: 3-5 weeks + estimated onboarding and infra uplift costs.
Noor CS: Thanks team. If Cerulean pushes earlier, we'll triage. Otherwise we'll finalize packet after the 2pm review and send as single PDF. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Reminder: CS-3033 review in 2 hours.
Noor CS: Closing loop here — ping me if anything changes. :pray:
